items.headline: CoreWeave's Q2 net interest expense more than doubles to $640M as total debt hits $35B
items.note: Even with a revenue and backlog beat, net interest expense more than doubled year-over-year and net losses widened on the back of it — a concrete sign of the rising debt-service burden building up at neoclouds.

items.headline: AIG CEO says AI data-center boom is 'maxing out' P&C insurers' capacity
items.note: A major insurer flagging strained underwriting capacity for AI infrastructure risk points to a thinning backstop just as more of the sector's debt gets pushed into insurance and pension balance sheets.
